body:
On Wed, Mar 2, 2016 at 6:25 PM, Domenic Denicola notifications@github.com
wrote:

> Hmm, was the list of pending interface actions something only applicable
> to the CanvasProxy setup? I didn't see it mentioned in the commit message
> exactly. Why not move it to the CanvasRenderingContext2D?
> 
> Actually, it is mentionned in commit(): in steps 4 and 5 of the "commit the
> scratch bitmap" algorithm, which is used by commit().

The idea of the actions being deferred by storing them into a list was to
synchronise the user interface actions with the presentation of canvas
content, which happens at commit() time.  Without CanvasProxy, the user
interface actions no longer need a formal deferral mechanism.

—

> https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/790/files#r54811092.

Oh damn, and I hounded @annevk on that one too in another PR :(. That english guidance would be clearer if it used a non-plural example though.

Regardless, right now the spec pretty consistently uses 's, so we should probably stick with that :(. Search for `s's` and there's 28 hits, 27 of which appear to be real and 3 of which (CSS's x2, template contents's) seem to be from Hixie. There are a few instances of `s'` that are for non-plurals, but they're rare and almost all canvas-related.
